entities.summary: Lucian Pulvermacher was an American Catholic priest and claimant to the papacy. He was the head of the True Catholic Church, a small conclavist group that elected him Pope Pius XIII in Montana in October 1998. At the time of his death, he lived in Springdale, Washington, United States.
